subject: Nebula Analytics — hybrid bundle visibility & co-sell readiness
thread_summary: Nebula wants to list a hybrid ISV bundle (Nebula + Redwood) across AWS and GCP marketplaces with a co-sell tag. Kimberly coordinates evidence and visibility asks, routes technical evidence to Ben for metering/sku mapping, and asks Karthik to validate co-sell eligibility and marketplace bundling constraints. Agreement to a short technical handoff call and pilot credits; external provided intake PDF and initial visibility matrix.
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@nebula.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Partnerships <partners@nebula.ai>
Date: 2029-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Listing Nebula+Redwood hybrid bundle across AWS/GCP marketplaces — initial ask

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this call last week. As mentioned, Nebula is packaging a ‘hybrid analytics’ bundle that combines our data pipeline + Redwood Inference as the model-serving component. We want to: 

- List the bundle on both AWS and GCP marketplaces (public listings)
- Explore a co-sell / sell-with qualification on both clouds
- Understand SKU visibility rules (can Redwood’s dedicated SKU be surfaced under the bundle?)

Can you confirm the high-level evidence we need for co-sell (metering, security, joint demo runbook)? I attached a short intake PDF with our current packaging and a first-pass visibility matrix.

Attachments: nebula-intake.pdf (PDF, 420KB), initial-visibility.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

High level ask: who at Redwood owns the bundle visibility map and co-sell evidence? Would appreciate contact and a proposed timeline for a go/no-go by end of month.

— Alex
Head of Partnerships, Nebula Analytics

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@nebula.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-08-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Listing Nebula+Redwood hybrid bundle across AWS/GCP marketplaces — initial ask

Alex —

Appreciate the packet and the clear ask. Quick notes and owners below: 

- Evidence / co-sell checklist owner: Karthik (copied). He’ll confirm whether the bundle meets our cloud partner co-sell prerequisites and flag any policy blockers.
- SKU & metering/visibility mapping: Ben will take the lead (copied) — he needs the final product SKU list + expected metering events to validate that Redwood’s SKU can be surfaced in a bundled purchase.
- Technical handoff & demo runbook: I’ll coordinate an internal playbook review with Product/DevRel and share a demo-runbook template.

Requested artifacts from Nebula to accelerate:
1) Final list of SKUs (Nebula + Redwood) you want in the bundle (CSV or spreadsheet)
2) Expected metering triggers and sample payloads (for entitlements)
3) A short security evidence pointer: SOC2 scope, where inference runs (hosted/dedicated/private)

Proposed timeline:
- EOD Fri (2029-08-16): Ben & Karthik confirm initial feasibility and list of outstanding items
- Week of 8/19: Tech handoff call (30–45m) to walk the runbook and metering examples
- Target: public listing readiness conversation by 8/30 (depends on legal/PO review)

Can you put the SKU list into the visibility matrix you already shared and re-upload? Karthik — can you confirm if we need any pre-cert for GCP sell-with? Ben — please advise if we need a stub SKU from Redwood for bundled billing.

Thanks — I’ll block a slot for next week once Alex confirms availability.

— Kimberly
Director, Go-to-Market Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Moreno <alex@nebula.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Partnerships <partners@nebula.ai>, procurement@nebula.ai
Date: 2029-08-12T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Listing Nebula+Redwood hybrid bundle across AWS/GCP marketplaces — initial ask

Kimberly — thanks, this is perfect. I’ve updated the visibility matrix and attached the formal co-sell intake form and a short security pointer doc. Quick answers inline: 

- SKUs: attached CSV shows Nebula core SKU (NEB-CORE-1) + Redwood inference runtime SKU (RWI-INFER-STD). We plan to surface Redwood SKU as a dependent SKU in the bundle.
- Metering: main trigger is per-inference-hour + auxiliary storage events. I included a sample metering payload for the inference call.
- Security: inference runs in a dedicated AWS account for initial pilots; SOC2 Type II report available — pointer in security-evidence.pdf.

Attachments: co-sell_intake_form.pdf (PDF, 230KB), bundle-visibility-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 160KB), security-evidence.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Pilot ask: can Redwood provide $5k in pilot credits for initial co-sell demos and a joint demo environment? If yes, we can include that in our internal approval for listing credits.

Availability for the tech call: Tue 8/20 anytime 10–2 PT or Wed 8/21 after 11 PT.

Best,
— Alex

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@nebula.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-08-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Listing Nebula+Redwood hybrid bundle across AWS/GCP marketplaces — initial ask

Alex —

Got the updated matrix and intake form, thank you. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- Pilot credits: I can provision a $5k pilot credit for Nebula under our PLG pilot program. Ben — will you handle the entitlement and billing stub?
- Co-sell eligibility: Karthik confirms we meet the preliminary criteria for co-sell on AWS; GCP requires an additional partner attestation (he’ll send the exact form).
- Tech call: Let’s book Tue 2029-08-20 at 11:00 PT — I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (demo, metering samples, entitlements).

Action owners: 
- Ben Carter: create Redwood stub SKU + entitlements mapping, confirm pilot credit workflow (due 2029-08-16)
- Karthik Iyer: send GCP attestation form and co-sell checklist (due 2029-08-16)
- Kimberly Park: send demo runbook template, schedule tech call (invite out today)

Related links: HubSpot deal recorded at https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/67890 (I added the intake PDF). Alex, please reply if you need DocuSign or a short MSA redline in advance of listing.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

— Kimberly
Director, Go-to-Market Partnerships
Redwood Inference
